prompt: A course management app for a small music academy: teachers create courses with title, level and price, students enroll, admins see enrollments per course.

alerts.title: high advisory in braces@3.0.3
alerts.explain: A known vulnerability affects a development-only tool (used to build or test the app). It is not shipped to your users and is not reachable at runtime.

report.headline: Melody Academy Manager built
report.overview: The app is a course management platform for music academies. It handles course creation, student enrollment, and administrative tracking. It was built using a standard SaaS CRUD recipe, with about 68% of the code reused from existing components.

criteria.criterion: A teacher can successfully save a new course with a title, level, and price.
criteria.evidence: End-to-end test: owner creates a course and sees it in the list

criteria.criterion: A student can enroll in an existing course.
criteria.evidence: End-to-end test: owner creates a enrollment and sees it in the list

criteria.criterion: An admin can view a list of all students enrolled in a specific course.
criteria.evidence: End-to-end test: owner creates a enrollment and sees it in the list

criteria.criterion: The system prevents a teacher from creating a course without a price.
criteria.evidence: Input validation with Zod schemas on every form and action

criteria.criterion: An admin can see the total number of enrollments for each course on a dashboard.

security.statusLine: All checks passed. The app ships with security headers, content security policy, input validation, role-based access checks, rate limiting, and safe error messages.
points: No issues were fixed automatically before delivery; nothing required it.

One high advisory remains in braces@3.0.3, but it affects development-only tools used to build or test the app. It is not shipped to your users and is not reachable at runtime, so it does not affect the live product.
